title: Job-shop repair frontier
description: K-bounded fixed-machine job-shop repair and change-count/completion-time frontiers. Includes 20 synthetic outage events and 153 integer-checked schedules. Separate HiGHS MILP optimality checks cover 24 points; the remaining 129 rely on the primary CP-SAT judgments. Code: Apache-2.0; original data/prose: CC BY 4.0; JobShopLib benchmark matrices retain MIT notices.
